% Highlights are supplied as a separate submission file.
\iffalse
\begin{highlights}
\item Unseen bearings cost SDALR 36 and SHOT 37 points, median over ten splits.
\item The large seen-unseen gap is already present before adaptation.
\item More source bearings and training data improve a forest on unseen bearings.
\item Envelope gates rarely flag healthy records but cover few faulty records.
\item Oracle filtering recovers 82\% of the gap; envelope gating adds 4.5 points.
\end{highlights}
\fi
